words.trans: v. 轻抚、温柔触碰（此处拟人写水草轻拂腿）
examples: Water weeds caressed the back of his legs.

words.trans: 句式：不由自主、不知不觉做某事（强调没刻意就做出了某动作/状态）
examples: He slumped on a chair to read the note again before it would sink in. "Crazy!" he found himself almost shouting to the walls.

words.trans: 习语：字面"毒蛇窝"，实际指龙潭虎穴、危机四伏、遍布敌人的险境
examples: Maggie and Joel were walking into a viper's nest.

words.trans: v. 潦草地写、草草书写
examples: He scribbled a message on the paper, rolled it up tight.

words.trans: n. 座机、固定电话（相对于手机 mobile）
examples: He picked up Uncle Ted's old landline that hung on the wall.

words.trans: 名词短语：（地形）地势起伏图、立体地势图（用阴影/色彩表现高低的山峦地图）
examples: He kept climbing until fells and valleys spread out like a relief map.

words.trans: n. 冷杉树（针叶常绿）
examples: He reached a small tarn enclosed with fir trees.

words.trans: n. 一缕（烟、雾）；wisps of mist 缕缕薄雾
examples: A small tarn, a few wisps of mist rising from the water.

words.trans: 短语：一片、一段（土地/水域，沿一个方向延伸的一条）
examples: He spotted their camping place on a stretch of solid ground running alongside a stream.

words.trans: adj.（口语）很深的、剧烈的；恶劣的；凶恶残暴的（vicious tyre marks 很深的轮胎印痕）
examples: Some vicious tyre marks told him all he needed to know.

words.trans: adj. 低矮敦实的（矮而粗短）；v./n. 蹲
examples: He began to cross the valley towards the squat grey set of buildings.

words.trans: 短语：突然绽开笑容（break into + 表情/反应，突然露出）
examples: He couldn't help breaking into a smile when he realized his escape left evidence everywhere.

words.trans: v. 乱挥、抽打（flail the bracken with sticks 用棍子乱扫蕨丛）
examples: A couple of men with dogs were descending towards the stream, flailing the waist-high bracken with sticks.

words.trans: 短语：不见……的踪影、没有……的迹象
examples: There was no sign of Maggie and Joel.

words.trans: adj.（树木/老枝）多节瘤的、扭曲粗糙的
examples: Something in the sky above the gnarled top of Sour Hollow Crag caught a flash of sunlight.

words.trans: adj. 庞大笨重的（bulk 体积）
examples: A hexacopter with a bulky fuselage was following the rim of the valley.

words.trans: n.（飞行器的）机身（承载乘客/设备的主体部分）
examples: A powerful-looking hexacopter with a bulky fuselage was searching the ground.

words.trans: 固定表达：一想到……就不寒而栗、不敢往下想
examples: He shuddered to think who might be at the controls somewhere in that building.

words.trans: 习语：不惜一切代价（= at any cost）
examples: Rufus Clay calmly gave orders to find the fugitive at all costs.

words.trans: 习语：机不可失、时不再来（要么现在就动手，要么永远没机会）
examples: The sky was clear above the farm. It was now or never.

words.trans: n. 狂乱、慌乱；in a frenzy 内心极度慌乱/狂躁
examples: He forced his shaking hands to relax, though his mind was in a frenzy.

words.trans: n. 鵟（大型猛禽，盘旋搜寻猎物）
examples: He angled into a steep glide, looking for the hatch like a buzzard hunting for prey.

words.trans: n. 杂乱一堆；a jumble of 一堆乱糟糟的……
examples: The shapeless grey rooftop began to separate into a jumble of gables and skylights.

words.trans: n.（建筑）山墙、三角墙（屋顶两侧的三角形墙）
examples: The rooftop separated into a jumble of gables and skylights, ducts and pipes.

words.trans: n.（野兽）巢穴；坏人老窝、藏身处（贬义）
examples: Finding that opening he'd spotted while he was inside Clay's lair was going to be impossible.

words.trans: adj. 有波纹的、瓦楞状的（压出平行褶皱沟槽以增强强度）
examples: The rooftop was full of slate and corrugated iron, but no way in.

words.trans: 名词短语：波纹铁皮、瓦楞铁皮（屋顶常用材料）
examples: The rooftop was full of slate and corrugated iron.

words.trans: 短语：一闪身迅速钻进（duck 低头躲避般快速进入）
examples: He ducked into the room full of bird drones.

words.trans: adj. 平静的、安静的（= calm，书面）
examples: The staring birds stood grimly tranquil on their perches and wires.

words.trans: n.（鸟）栖木、栖息架；v. 栖息、落在高处
examples: The staring birds stood grimly tranquil on their perches and wires.

words.trans: 短语：（屏幕画面）闪现、跳出来
examples: As they flashed up on the screen, he thought they would win a wildlife competition.

words.word: stand a better chance of doing
words.trans: 固定句式：有更大机会做某事、更有可能做……（stand a chance of 有机会）
examples: He thought the photos would stand a better chance of winning a wildlife competition than incriminating Clay.
words.key: stand a better chance of doing

words.trans: v. 使显出有罪、连累、指控……涉案（作犯罪证据）
examples: They would stand a better chance of winning a wildlife prize than incriminating Rufus Clay as a terrorist mastermind.

words.trans: 常用表达：脉搏狂跳、心跳加速（紧张/恐惧时）
examples: He was back in the cell, his pulse racing.

words.trans: v. 使安心、消除疑虑（re- 再 + assure 保证）
examples: He had to gulp air to reassure himself he was miles away in his workshop.

words.trans: 短语：正在赶来的路上（= coming/en route）
examples: He gulped air to reassure himself that the police were on their way.

words.trans: v. 原路折返、重走来路；retrace the route 重走那条路线
examples: He retraced the route Mike McCain had taken him, until he faced that unmarked door.

words.trans: 短语：全盘考虑、彻底想明白（把每步后果都想清楚）
examples: This was a dead end he had not thought through.

words.trans: 短语：（灯火/火）熄灭、被吹灭
examples: He saw the light go out.

words.trans: 名词短语：机头锥、飞行器头部整流锥罩
examples: He promised to build a microphone into Skylark's nose cone.

words.trans: n. 门槛、门口（引申：临界点、开端）
examples: Rufus Clay stood in the threshold, blinking.

words.trans: 短语：飞速冲过、掠过（从上方快速飞过）
examples: Tom shot over his head, into the office, and landed on the desk.

words.trans: adj. 方方正正的（像箱子一样）
examples: Behind them was some kind of boxy concrete structure and a cluster of palm trees.

words.trans: adj. 庄重威严的、气派的（stately manor 庄严府邸）
examples: There on a stand was the peregrine falcon, stately and statuesque.

words.trans: adj.（尤女子）雕像般高大端庄的、颀长秀美的
examples: The peregrine falcon stood stately and statuesque on a stand.

words.trans: n. 空洞、腔体（牙洞/胸腔等空腔）
examples: It had a cavity open in its chest, revealing entrails of bright components.

words.trans: n.〔复数〕内脏；此处引申（机器）内部构件、内藏
examples: A cavity open in its chest revealed entrails of bright components.

words.trans: v. 大步逼近；（像猎食动物）蹑手蹑脚悄悄靠近（stalk one's way closer 一步步逼近）
examples: He stalked his way closer, wary but curious, step by step, to Skylark.

words.trans: 短语：停下来（车/滚动物体停住）
examples: He saw the canister roll out across the desk and come to a stop.

words.trans: v.（嘴角/肌肉）抽动、微动
examples: He thought he saw the corners of Rufus Clay's mouth twitch into the faintest smile.

words.trans: 固定习语（拍照专用）：为了相机（拍出来好看）而微笑；摄影师常说 Smile for the camera!
examples: He recited the message on the note: Smile for the camera.
